**Finding submitted — EXCLUSIVITY: deviation (high).**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 10.3(A) (p0183) — Customer "shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee" for the whole "Term," defined at p0049 as eight years from the Commencement Date.
- **Why it fails fallback:** no defined product-category limit, no 12-month cap, and no automatic termination of the commitment on M&I's failure to meet the Article 9 Performance Standards or processing/delivery deadlines — i.e. full-term exclusive dealing with no performance-based exit (walk-away).
- **Locations cleared:** Section 21.10 (scope of affiliate processing), 21.11 (fee-schedule/acquisition assumptions), the Section 1.1(C) recital, and all other "exclusive" hits (Customer Data ownership, venue, non-exclusive source-code licence) are not sourcing covenants against Customer.
- **Cure (preferred, one operation):** the offending sentence is replaced with non-exclusive-provider language; the Monthly Base Fee pricing acknowledgment and all surrounding text are preserved, and the comment offers the category/12-month/performance-exit fallback.
